# PathoMitra — LLM Context File
# https://llmstxt.org

# PathoMitra is an offline-first digital pathology laboratory management system.
# It provides patient record management, laboratory test reporting, doctor management,
# invoicing and revenue analytics — entirely on-device, with no server and no accounts.

> PathoMitra is an offline, local-first digital pathology lab management system for
> clinical laboratories. All data is stored in an encrypted on-device database
> (SQLCipher, AES-256, key in the Android hardware keystore). The Android build requests
> no INTERNET permission, ships no analytics or crash reporting, and never transmits
> patient data. Access is guarded by a single local operator account with a
> PBKDF2-hashed passcode and an optional biometric unlock.

## Core Features

- Patient management — add, search and track patient records with full lab history
- Lab report generation — create, fill and export PDF reports for 40+ pathology tests, with four templates and age/sex reference-range flagging
- Drafts and amendment history — a report issues once; amendments bump the version and record who changed them and when
- Custom tests and profiles — user-defined tests, units, groups and reference boundaries
- Doctor directory — referring doctor profiles and contact information
- Invoicing and revenue analytics — daily, monthly and cumulative revenue with charts
- Notification centre — derived alerts for overdue reports, unissued drafts and unpaid bills
- Encrypted local storage with operator-owned JSON backups and in-app data erase
- Local authentication — passcode plus optional biometric / device-credential unlock, with auto re-lock

## Platforms

- Android (APK / AAB via Capacitor 8) — the production target; no network permission
- Web build — deployed to Cloudflare Pages for evaluation; installable as a PWA

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://pathomitra.pages.dev/) — Landing page with product overview
- [Technology](https://pathomitra.pages.dev/technology) — Technology and security overview
- [Solutions](https://pathomitra.pages.dev/solutions) — Feature descriptions and use cases

## Private Pages (local operator unlock required)

- /dashboard — Main application dashboard
- /auth — Local operator unlock

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript (strict), Vite, Tailwind CSS 4
- Native shell: Capacitor 8 (Android) with the community SQLCipher SQLite plugin
- Data: encrypted on-device SQLite (SQLCipher AES-256) behind a collection façade; Android Keystore for secrets
- PDF: jsPDF + jsPDF-AutoTable
- Validation: Zod
- Web hosting: Cloudflare Pages
